# Pixel Interval Trainer

A simple offline interval timer for work/rest cycles.

## Features
- Set work seconds, rest seconds, and number of rounds.
- Start button begins the countdown.
- Displays current phase (Work/Rest), remaining seconds, and round number.
- Shows "Workout complete!" at the end.
- Keyboard accessible controls with visible focus states.

## Usage
Open `index.html` in any modern browser. No server or network required.

## Files
- `index.html` – main page structure
- `style.css` – styling
- `script.js` – timer logic
